activation_condition: A local memory index or maintenance surface may be stale
steps: Run the doctor or status command to identify the stale surface
Run the narrow maintenance command with an explicit project scope
Re-run the diagnostic command to verify the stale surface is repaired
termination_condition: The diagnostic command no longer reports the stale condition
success_examples: harness-mem doctor reports the exact index rebuild hint
harness-mem doctor no longer reports missing exact-search postings
